# FLX-5021: draw parameter outside its declared domain

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

A kernel sampler was asked for a draw it cannot form -- a probability outside [0, 1], a non-positive rate, a bound below 1, an interval whose lower end is above its upper end, or a scale on which no value of the declared interval is representable. The kernel refuses rather than substituting a default, because the substituted value would be hashed into the run digest and no reader could tell it apart from an authored one (KERNEL-SPEC §4).

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5021
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
